g.text: Number of combatants and civilians who died due to fighting in armed conflicts between 1989 and 2025.

text.style: font-size: 15.84px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: This excludes deaths due to disease and starvation, which can make the death tolls much larger.

g.text: An armed conflict is defined here as a disagreement between organized groups, or between one organized group and civilians, that causes at least 25 deaths during a year.
